title: Manijero olive-grove procedure map
description: Versioned taxonomy index of the olive-grove procedures the assistant is meant to cover. This file is the readable contract; backend/app/procedure_map.py is the executable validator and must stay in sync with it. The map is not legal knowledge and not an answer source: it carries no dates, amounts, thresholds, article numbers, eligibility conclusions, or applicability claims, and it never approves, retires, or re-dates evidence. The executable validator also enforces rules this schema cannot express: the pinned ordered seed set, duplicate ids across topics, search-wording uniqueness, and cross-file resolution of source and passage ids. The no-digit and length limits below are enforced by both. Missing coverage is reported, never a validation failure.

schema_version.description: Map format version. Bump it, the schema, and the validator together in a reviewed change.

topics.description: Ordered seed topics. The executable validator pins the exact ordered ids from MasterPlanV3 section 7.3 and rejects a missing or unknown topic; adding a topic is a reviewed schema, validator, and data change.

topicId.description: Stable lowercase topic slug. Never derive it from a title and never reuse it.

referenceId.description: Approved catalog source id or reviewed passage id. The executable validator resolves it only when both reference files are supplied.

humanText.description: Plain-Spanish human-readable text. Must be non-blank and must not contain digits, because the map is a taxonomy index, not legal knowledge.

coverage.description: Honest declaration of reviewed evidence, not a coverage gate. Gaps are reported and never make the map invalid. Cross-file reference resolution is validator-only.

state.description: covered means reviewed evidence exists; partial means some steps are mapped and a gap note names the rest; uncovered means no reviewed evidence is mapped yet.

source_ids.description: Approved source ids that support this topic. Empty when uncovered; at least one when covered or partial.

passage_ids.description: Reviewed passage ids that support this topic. Empty when uncovered; at least one when covered or partial. Each passage's source must appear in source_ids.

gap_note.description: Required for partial coverage: names what reviewed evidence is missing, without dates, amounts, or article numbers.

topic.description: One olive-grove procedure. Review provenance is Git; the map carries no date fields.

title.description: Plain-Spanish procedure name. No digits, dates, amounts, or article numbers.

summary.description: One or two plain-Spanish sentences describing the procedure. No digits and no eligibility or applicability claim.

search_terms.description: Plain-Spanish phrases for later source scouting, question rewriting, and suggested questions. Digit-free; the executable validator also rejects wording repeated within or across topics.

review_status.description: proposed is the only unreviewed default. reviewed requires a named human reviewer in a reviewed change.

reviewed_by.description: Named human reviewer. Present only when review_status is reviewed.
